results.name: Nat.ModEq.sum
results.source_text:
@[gcongr]
protected theorem sum {s : Finset α} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≡ g x [MOD n]) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, f x) ≡ ∑ x ∈ s, g x [MOD n] :=
  .multisetSum_map (s := s.1) h

results.name: finsum
results.source_text:
/-- Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise. -/
noncomputable irreducible_def finsum (lemma := finsum_def') [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : M :=
  if h : HasFiniteSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0
results.docstring:
Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise.

results.name: KroneckerDelta.kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv
results.source_text:
/-- The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`. -/
lemma kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    kroneckerDelta (finSumFinEquiv a) (finSumFinEquiv b) = kroneckerDelta a b := by
  simp only [kroneckerDelta, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
results.docstring: The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`.

results.name: Finset.card_filter
results.source_text:
lemma card_filter (p) [DecidablePred p] (s : Finset ι) :
    #{i ∈ s | p i} = ∑ i ∈ s, ite (p i) 1 0 := by simp [sum_ite]

results.name: Finset.natCast_card_filter
results.source_text:
lemma natCast_card_filter (p) [DecidablePred p] (s : Finset ι) :
    (#{x ∈ s | p x} : R) = ∑ a ∈ s, if p a then (1 : R) else 0 := by
  rw [sum_ite, sum_const_zero, add_zero, sum_const, nsmul_one]

results.name: Finset.card
results.source_text:
/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1
results.docstring:

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale.

lemma prod_mulIndicator_eq_prod_filter (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ → β) (t : ι → Set κ) (g : ι → κ)

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
